Craft to contemporary

Where Nigeria's craft heritage meets contemporary design.

NDD connects northern and southern craft traditions with today's architects, interior designers and fashion houses, and always shows the maker alongside the designer.

  • Adire
  • Kano dye pits
  • Bida brass & glass
  • Aso Oke
  • Kaduna & Kano textiles
  • Leatherwork
  • Woodcarving
About the Craft Exchange

A district without walls

How NDD grows

NDD starts as a curated network of members and programmes. It grows toward a physical home once the community has proved itself, with each stage earning the next.

  1. Nov 2026 – Mar 2027 · Now

    1. Founding Network

    A curated group of founding members, the NDD brand, and a calendar of events hosted in member studios and partner venues.

  2. 2027

    2. Pilot District

    NDD Abuja becomes a recognised cluster: a shared map and signage, a regular Open Studios trail, a pop-up showroom and the first NDD Week.

  3. 2028 onward

    3. Anchor Hub & new locations

    A physical home for NDD Abuja, with a showroom, material library, co-working and event space, then new NDD locations in other cities.

Ways to be part of NDD

Compare tiers →

Founding membership opens in January 2027, with a founding rate for members who commit for 12 months.

  1. 01

    Founding Patron

    Established firms and brands that anchor NDD in its first year. Limited to 8–12.

    Register interest →
  2. 02

    Studio Member

    Practising firms, studios and brands across all six pillars.

    Register interest →
  3. 03

    Maker / Emerging

    Artisans, young designers, graduates and small makers, at subsidised fees.

    Register interest →
  4. 04

    Friend of NDD

    Clients, collectors, developers and design lovers.

    Register interest →
